label: Temperament
description: Biologically rooted, early-appearing dispositions in reactivity and self-regulation; the initial conditions of the person

label: Development
description: The person's developmental course; the stratum that writes and gates the weights of all other strata over time (w_ij(t) = g_ij(t)·w̄_ij)

label: Personality
description: The organized pattern of dispositional traits (Big Five + 30 facets), characteristic adaptations, and narrative identity

label: Needs
description: Seven-domain system of necessities (existence, safety, relatedness, esteem, competence, autonomy, meaning) with dual satisfaction/frustration channels

label: Motivation–Emotion
guiding_question: What do you want and feel?
description: One valuation process with two coupled readouts: motivation (direction, intensity, persistence) and componential emotion

label: Psychopathology
description: Hierarchical dimensional structure of disorder (p → superspectra → spectra → subfactors) with cross-spectral and self-maintaining edges

label: Therapy
description: Universal therapy workflow (triage → frame → alliance → assessment → formulation → goals → change work → practice → monitoring → review → consolidation); the system's exogenous control channel
primary_source: Frank & Frank (1991)*; APA Presidential Task Force (2006)

label: Systems / Environment
description: The person as autopoietic unity structurally coupled to nested ecological strata (micro/meso/exo/macro/chrono) including state, economy, and culture
